conversation.text: Hi again! The session went wonderfully. We are now planning a bigger year-end celebration for the whole firm, about 40 people, in December.

**Subject: Your Year-End Celebration in December**

Hi the client,

Thank you for the kind words — it was a pleasure hosting your team, and I'm glad the session went so well.

It's exciting to hear you're planning a year-end celebration for the whole firm. Noting around 40 guests in December, we've hosted similar celebrations for teams of that size, so we're well set up to make it a memorable evening.

To get started, could you let me know if you have a specific date in December in mind, and what time you'd like the celebration to begin?

Once I have those details, I'll put together some options for you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
